description: Test cases for SAP BTP + ABAP Cloud extensibility skill.

evals.name: rap-vs-cap-decision
evals.prompt: Necesito crear una extensión custom para approval workflow de timesheet. ¿ABAP Cloud RAP o CAP en BTP?
evals.expected_output: Decision matrix RAP vs CAP con rationale
assertions: RAP criteria: tightly coupled, same S/4HANA system
CAP criteria: loosely coupled, external users, independent lifecycle

evals.name: key-user-first
evals.prompt: Usuario quiere agregar campo custom a Sales Order. ¿Key User o RAP?
evals.expected_output: Key User Extensibility first — no code needed
assertions: NO recomienda RAP para este caso simple

evals.name: btp-subaccount-architecture
evals.prompt: Diseña arquitectura BTP subaccounts para AcmeCorp multi-país
